title: Not worth the money, for me anyhow.
text: I signed up for this because a certain other outdoor box had truly cheapened what they sent you and I had canceled it. This one looked to have more and better items. What I received in my first box was not of use to me and I canceled after the intro box. That said, the value was there if you believe the pricing and the items may be of use to you.
label: negative
